subject: imageRename - error in copying images and renaming them

messages.subject: imageRename - error in copying images and renaming them
parts:
Hello there,

I am using camtrapR to organize my cameratrap data and it is working fine until I tried to use the command "imageRename". I use windows 10.
I already had my pictures' names changed to a format using date and time. Example of a file name: "2018 09 11 14 38 31.JPG"

I have a structured mother directory with stations and cameras subdirectories, Within the cameras directories, pictures are sorted in subdirectories with the species names, such as:
"E://CameraTrapPicSF//Piloto_2018//Pil01//Cam01//Arancua//2018 09 11 14 38 31.JPG"

It worked fine like this to use the command recordTable. But my interest is to use recordTableIndividual for one of the species. Going through the workflow of the package, it says that all my species-of-interest's pictures should be inside one directory ending with the species name, which inside pictures would be organized by stations (but not cameras). So I came up with the situation that I want to rename my pictures using date and time (as I already have) but also adding stationID and cameraID, and this is where I am having trouble. I already have the outDir (for renamed pictures) directory ready with the same station structure as inDir, but the command imageRename gets an error at the end of the procedure, in the copying/renaming part of it.

Below is the code I am running:

imageRename(inDir = "E://CameraTrapPicSF//Piloto_2018",
outDir = "E://CameraTrapPicSF//Piloto_2018_Rename",
hasCameraFolders = TRUE,
keepCameraSubfolders = TRUE,
createEmptyDirectories = TRUE,
copyImages = TRUE,
writecsv = TRUE)

The output comes as this:


Pil01 : 180 images
Pil02 : 55 images
Pil03 : 787 images
Pil04 : 233 images
Pil05 : 513 images
Pil06 : 293 images
Pil07 : 792 images

Pil10 : 197 images
Pil11 : 132 images
Pil12 : 1216 images
Pil13 : 387 images
Pil14 : 359 images
Pil15 : 318 images
Pil16 : 376 images
Pil17 : 205 images
copying 6119 images to E://CameraTrapPicSF//Piloto_2018_Rename  ... This may take some time.
cannot create file 'E://CameraTrapPicSF//Piloto_2018_Rename/Pil01/Cam01/Pil01__Cam01__2018-09-08__14-13-29(1).JPG', reason 'No such file or directory' ##THIS MESSAGE IS THE SAME FOR ALL IMAGES.

After all that the only thing in the outDir is a csv file: "_renaming_table_2019-05-03.csv", which I attached at this message.
I would like some help to solve this issue. Other wise, I would like an idea of how producing my record table for individualsof one species if my filenames do not have station and camera IDs.

Thanks a lot for the attention,
Henrique

messages.subject: Re: imageRename - error in copying images and renaming them
parts:
Hi,
what is the reason for the double forward slashes in the path names? Can you try with single forward slashes please? I.e.,

inDir = "E:/CameraTrapPicSF/Piloto_2018"

and likewise for outDir.
If that doesn't solve the problem, we'll have a closer look.
